parts.text:
The drag force $F_{\mathrm{D}}$ acting on a sphere moving through a fluid is given by the expression

$F_{\mathrm{D}}=K\rho v^2$

where $K$ is a constant, $\rho$ is the density of the fluid and $v$ is the speed of the sphere.
Determine the SI base units of K.
